note: Tier A props (account D, art/level/tier_a/tools/bake_props.py). Keys beyond the contract: state.pxPerFrame (advance by travel), hinge (px, the topple pivot in the frame), render.normals. Phase B (12.11): cat_gag, cat_glass, bell, time_clock, placard_tea, placard_clock, camera_crew.

stand.note: frame 0 = the still intact missile (shadow re-baked)

topple.note: tips to the LEFT (flip for right) about its base-left corner, angles 0,4,10,18,28

topple_b.note: angles 40,54,70,90; whole fall 30 ticks, angle ~ t^2 (a falling tree)

sled.note: lying on its side; the game moves it (the sled); shake and squash are RENDER

missile_topple.note: gag 5. Sim states topple and sled are NEW on missile_goal (GAMEPLAY adds them). The sheet is 3 rows because 9 frames in one row would pass 4096 px.

roll.note: the crown entity moves it; advance one frame per pxPerFrame of travel (no slide); flip for rolling left

hop.note: the dodge and the hop over the corpse: the same spin, faster, in the air (shadow then drawn by the renderer)

still.note: lying still, upright on its band, the shine up

crown_roll.note: gag 12. Built from the king's OWN crown pixels (chars/king/idle_00, rows 19-28, cols 44-59): it matches his sprite exactly.

rattle.note: the lid hops on the samovar; 30 ticks then lid_off

samovar_whistle.note: gag 5's end: sim states whistle and lid_off are NEW on samovar_corner. Cut from the level's own samovar_corner_intact (rows 0-14, cols 36-56): if that art is redrawn, re-run bake_props.py.

fly.note: pops 2.5 cells up, 1.8 cells right (vx = cells/s along the samovar facing, a key beyond the contract); lands: one 8-tick bounce of 0.25 cell, then still

still.note: lying on the ground, its contact shadow baked; anchor here = its foot

samovar_lid.note: gag 5: the lid, its own piece. The win screen waits for lid landing + 60 ticks.

spots.note: catwalk A, its right end: the glass goes off at x 31 (the samovar at 33)
catwalk B, its left end: the barrel goes off at x 93 onto the ambush clones at 90.5-92.5
the launch console by the missile: the level has none yet (the booth at 13.5 is far from the missile); LEVEL adds it

sit.note: calm; the tail tip flicks now and then

stare.note: only the tail tip and one ear move; 48 ticks = one pass (proposal; the bible says 12)

push.note: paw lift 20 ticks, then the slow push: the cat creeps 1 px a step for 70 ticks, still staring (90 in all; the bible says 30). pawTip = the paw contact px per frame: the glass or barrel rides it

push_hold.note: frame 8 of row 2 held (the paw still out) until GAMEPLAY moves on: keeps staring

jump.note: crouch 8, leap 14 (GAMEPLAY moves it along the arc; no shadow in the air), land 6

hover.note: the paw over the button: 90 ticks (proposal; bible 50), only the tail moves

press.note: TOK on its first frame: cat:press

cat_gag.note: gag 2, the cat that is never hurt. From painted sheet 242 by majority colour into its own 15-colour palette (fur, stripe, cream, cool rim, eye, pink), 1 px outline; anchor = the ground under its hind feet. Keys beyond the contract: state.pawTip (px per frame), state.start (first frame of the row), invulnerable.

spots.note: GAMEPLAY places it: a wall above the clones, by the 1:30 trigger

ring.note: the painted bell turns on its bracket (0, +-5, +-10 deg, RotSprite), the clapper one frame behind; 44 ticks then still

bell.note: gag 10. Anchor = the wall plate centre (bolt it to the rock). Its wall shadow is baked.

spots.note: GAMEPLAY places it where the strike clones punch in

idle.note: a card waits half in the slot

punch.note: the card goes in 1 px a step, CLUNK on frame 5 (the lever dips): the strike clone may now explode

time_clock.note: gag 10. The clock face has hands only, no numbers.

on.note: on the wall layer floor (groundPx 596), in its haze; repeats with its tileX

render.note: the wall haze is baked into its palette (30 % fog, 85 % value)

flinch.note: duck, lower, hold; started by the blame bark (gag 1)

camera_crew.note: gag 1: a tiny TV crew in the painted background, about half the hero height (it stands far back)

still.note: on the ledge; while pushed GAMEPLAY keeps it at the cat push pawTip

fall.note: tumbles off the ledge; on the ground the chink and the smash (FX builder: fx_glass_smash)

cat_glass.note: gag 2 beat 1: a tea glass, full; hand-placed pixels (7x9), its own 6 colours

spots.note: GAMEPLAY: by the time clock during the strike

placard_tea.note: gag 10 strike: a placard leaning on the wall (+7 deg), pictures only, its wall shadow baked

spots.note: GAMEPLAY: by the time clock during the strike

placard_clock.note: gag 10 strike: a placard leaning on the wall (-6 deg), pictures only, its wall shadow baked
